description: Adjusts facial expression, pose and gaze in a supplied photo using numeric controls. Costs 1 credit per edit; output size depends on the subscription tier. Starts a background job; returns a project id for wait_for_image_project.

assets.description: Provide the assets for face editor

image_file_path.description:
This is the image whose face will be edited. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

name.description: Give your image a custom name for easy identification.

eye_gaze_horizontal.description: Horizontal eye gaze (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

eye_gaze_vertical.description: Vertical eye gaze (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

eye_open_ratio.description: Eye open ratio (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

eyebrow_direction.description: Eyebrow direction (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

head_pitch.description: Head pitch (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

head_roll.description: Head roll (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

head_yaw.description: Head yaw (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

lip_open_ratio.description: Lip open ratio (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

mouth_grim.description: Mouth grim (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

mouth_position_horizontal.description: Horizontal mouth position (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

mouth_position_vertical.description: Vertical mouth position (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

mouth_pout.description: Mouth pout (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

mouth_purse.description: Mouth purse (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

mouth_smile.description: Mouth smile (-100 to 100), in increments of 5

name: edit_face_in_photo

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the image. We charge credits right when the request is made. 

If an error occurred while generating the image(s), credits will be refunded and this field will be updated to include the refund.

id.description: Unique ID of the image. Use it with the [Get image Project API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/image-projects/get-image-details) to fetch status and downloads.
